buildings.name: Cursor
buildings.desc: Autoclicks once every 10 seconds.
buildings.foolDesc: Essential in flattening dough. The first step in cookie-making.

buildings.name: Grandma
buildings.desc: A nice grandma to bake more cookies.
buildings.foolDesc: A crucial element of baking cookies.

buildings.name: Farm
buildings.desc: Grows cookie plants from cookie seeds.
buildings.foolDesc: The more kitchens, the more cookies your employees can produce.

buildings.name: Mine
buildings.desc: Mines out cookie dough and chocolate chips.
buildings.foolDesc: These give you the edge you need to outsell those pesky competitors.

buildings.name: Factory
buildings.desc: Produces large quantities of cookies.
buildings.foolDesc: Mass production is the future of baking. Seize the day, and synergize!

buildings.name: Bank
buildings.desc: Generates cookies from interest.
buildings.foolDesc: Ready to finance your venture as long as there's money to be made.

buildings.name: Temple
buildings.desc: Full of precious, ancient chocolate.
buildings.foolDesc: Your social media page is going viral! This is the key to juicy advertising deals.

buildings.name: Wizard tower
buildings.desc: Summons cookies with magic spells.
buildings.foolDesc: Cookie memes are all the rage! Astroturf your brand image all over the cyberspace.

buildings.name: Shipment
buildings.desc: Brings in fresh cookies from the cookie planet.
buildings.foolDesc: A gigantic cookie emporium - your very own retail chain.

buildings.name: Alchemy lab
buildings.desc: Turns gold into cookies!
buildings.foolDesc: You're officially on the stock market, and everyone wants a piece!

buildings.name: Portal
buildings.desc: Opens a door to the Cookieverse.
buildings.foolDesc: Your cookies have their own sitcom! Hilarious baking hijinks set to the cheesiest laughtrack.

buildings.name: Time machine
buildings.desc: Brings cookies from the past, before they were even eaten.
buildings.foolDesc: Cookie theme parks, full of mascots and roller-coasters. Build one, build a hundred!

buildings.name: Antimatter condenser
buildings.desc: Condenses the antimatter in the universe into cookies.
buildings.foolDesc: A virtual currency, already replacing regular money in some small countries.

buildings.name: Prism
buildings.desc: Converts light itself into cookies.
buildings.foolDesc: You've made it to the top, and you can now buy entire nations to further your corporate greed.

buildings.name: Chancemaker
buildings.desc: Generates cookies out of thin air through sheer luck.
buildings.foolDesc: A whole planet dedicated to producing, advertising, selling, and consuming your cookies.

buildings.name: Fractal engine
buildings.desc: Turns cookies into even more cookies.
buildings.foolDesc: Only through political dominion can you create a brighter, more cookie-friendly future.

buildings.name: Javascript console
buildings.desc: Creates cookies from the very code this game was written in.
buildings.foolDesc: Reshape civilization, ensuring a unified goal for future generations: acquiring more cookies.

buildings.name: Idleverse
buildings.desc: Convert other idle universes to produce cookies for you.
buildings.foolDesc: Sometimes the best way up is sideways. Diversify your ventures through non-cookie investments.

buildings.name: Cortex baker
buildings.desc: Artificial planet-brains that can dream up cookies into existence.
buildings.foolDesc: Hire the most brilliant experts in the known universe and let them scrape their brains for your benefit!

buildings.name: You
buildings.desc: More of you, to make even more cookies.
buildings.foolDesc: Your business is as great as it's gonna get. Focus on yourself and become the best-ever CEO.

buildings.name: Black hole
buildings.desc: Pulls in cookies from across the universe and squeezes them into denser, tastier ones.
buildings.foolDesc: A cookie jar so deep, nobody has ever seen the bottom.

buildings.name: Galaxy
buildings.desc: A whole spiral of a billion cookie-stars, slowly turning towards your bank account.
buildings.foolDesc: An assortment of every cookie flavor. Somebody always takes the last good one.

buildings.name: Multiverse mixer
buildings.desc: Stirs every possible universe together into one enormous bowl of cookie batter.
buildings.foolDesc: Every kitchen's best friend. Also very loud.

buildings.name: Big bang
buildings.desc: Restarts reality from scratch, over and over, keeping only the cookies each time.
buildings.foolDesc: Celebrate good times with a little explosion of confetti.

upgrades.name: Plain cookies
upgrades.q: We all gotta start somewhere.

upgrades.name: Sugar cookies
upgrades.q: Tasty, if a little unimaginative.

upgrades.name: Oatmeal raisin cookies
upgrades.q: No raisin to hate these.

upgrades.name: Peanut butter cookies
upgrades.q: Get yourself some jam cookies!

upgrades.name: Coconut cookies
upgrades.q: Flaky, but not unreliable. Some people go crazy for these.

upgrades.name: White chocolate cookies
upgrades.q:
I know what you'll say. It's just cocoa butter! It's not real chocolate!
Oh please.

upgrades.name: Macadamia nut cookies
upgrades.q: They're macadamn delicious!

upgrades.name: Double-chip cookies
upgrades.q:
DOUBLE THE CHIPS
DOUBLE THE TASTY
(double the calories)

upgrades.name: White chocolate macadamia nut cookies
upgrades.q: Orteil's favorite.

upgrades.name: All-chocolate cookies
upgrades.q: CHOCOVERDOSE.

upgrades.name: Dark chocolate-coated cookies
upgrades.q: These absorb light so well you almost need to squint to see them.

upgrades.name: White chocolate-coated cookies
upgrades.q: These dazzling cookies absolutely glisten with flavor.

upgrades.name: Eclipse cookies
upgrades.q: Look to the cookie.

upgrades.name: Snickerdoodles
upgrades.q: True to their name.

upgrades.name: Stroopwafels
upgrades.q: If it ain't dutch, it ain't much.

upgrades.name: Macaroons
upgrades.q:
Not to be confused with macarons.
These have coconut, okay?

upgrades.name: Empire biscuits
upgrades.q: For your growing cookie empire, of course!

upgrades.name: British tea biscuits
upgrades.q: Quite.

upgrades.name: Chocolate british tea biscuits
upgrades.q: Yes, quite.

upgrades.name: Round british tea biscuits
upgrades.q: Yes, quite riveting.

upgrades.name: Round chocolate british tea biscuits
upgrades.q: Yes, quite riveting indeed.

upgrades.name: Round british tea biscuits with heart motif
upgrades.q: Yes, quite riveting, old chap.

upgrades.name: Round chocolate british tea biscuits with heart motif
upgrades.q: I like cookies.

upgrades.name: Madeleines
upgrades.q: Unforgettable!

upgrades.name: Palmiers
upgrades.q: Palmier than you!

upgrades.name: Palets
upgrades.q:
You could probably play hockey with these.
I mean, you're welcome to try.

upgrades.name: Sablés
upgrades.q: The name implies they're made of sand. But you know better, don't you?

upgrades.name: Caramoas
upgrades.q: Yeah. That's got a nice ring to it.

upgrades.name: Sagalongs
upgrades.q: Grandma's favorite?

upgrades.name: Shortfoils
upgrades.q: Foiled again!

upgrades.name: Win mints
upgrades.q: They're the luckiest cookies you've ever tasted!

upgrades.name: Fig gluttons
upgrades.q: Got it all figured out.

upgrades.name: Loreols
upgrades.q: Because, uh... they're worth it?

upgrades.name: Jaffa cakes
upgrades.q: If you want to bake a cookie from scratch, you must first build a factory.

upgrades.name: Grease's cups
upgrades.q: Extra-greasy peanut butter.

upgrades.name: Gingerbread men
upgrades.q: You like to bite the legs off first, right? How about tearing off the arms? You sick monster.

upgrades.name: Gingerbread trees
upgrades.q: Evergreens in pastry form. Yule be surprised what you can come up with.

upgrades.name: Rose macarons
upgrades.q: Although an odd flavor, these pastries recently rose in popularity.

upgrades.name: Lemon macarons
upgrades.q: Tastefully sour, delightful treats.

upgrades.name: Chocolate macarons
upgrades.q: They're like tiny sugary burgers!

upgrades.name: Pistachio macarons
upgrades.q: Pistachio shells now removed after multiple complaints.

upgrades.name: Hazelnut macarons
upgrades.q: These go especially well with coffee.

upgrades.name: Violet macarons
upgrades.q: It's like spraying perfume into your mouth!

upgrades.name: Caramel macarons
upgrades.q: The saltiest, chewiest of them all.

upgrades.name: Licorice macarons
upgrades.q: Also known as "blackarons".

upgrades.name: Pure black chocolate cookies
upgrades.q: Dipped in a lab-made substance darker than the darkest cocoa (dubbed "chocoalate").

upgrades.name: Pure white chocolate cookies
upgrades.q: Elaborated on the nano-scale, the coating on this biscuit is able to refract light even in a pitch-black environment.

upgrades.name: Ladyfingers
upgrades.q: Cleaned and sanitized so well you'd swear they're actual biscuits.

upgrades.name: Tuiles
upgrades.q: These never go out of tile.

upgrades.name: Chocolate-stuffed biscuits
upgrades.q:
A princely snack!
The holes are so the chocolate stuffing can breathe.

upgrades.name: Checker cookies
upgrades.q: A square cookie? This solves so many storage and packaging problems! You're a genius!

upgrades.name: Butter cookies
upgrades.q: These melt right off your mouth and into your heart. (Let's face it, they're rather fattening.)

upgrades.name: Cream cookies
upgrades.q: It's like two chocolate chip cookies! But brought together with the magic of cream! It's fiendishly perfect!

upgrades.name: Gingersnaps
upgrades.q: Cookies with a soul. Probably.

upgrades.name: Cinnamon cookies
upgrades.q: The secret is in the patented swirly glazing.

upgrades.name: Vanity cookies
upgrades.q: One tiny candied fruit sits atop this decadent cookie.

upgrades.name: Cigars
upgrades.q: Close, but no match for those extravagant cookie straws they serve in coffee shops these days.

upgrades.name: Pinwheel cookies
upgrades.q: Bringing you the dizzying combination of brown flavor and beige taste!

upgrades.name: Fudge squares
upgrades.q:
Not exactly cookies, but you won't care once you've tasted one of these.
They're so good, it's fudged-up!

upgrades.name: Digits
upgrades.q: Three flavors, zero phalanges.

upgrades.name: Butter horseshoes
upgrades.q: It would behoove you to not overindulge in these.

upgrades.name: Butter pucks
upgrades.q:
Lord, what fools these mortals be!
(This is kind of a hokey reference.)

upgrades.name: Butter knots
upgrades.q: Look, you can call these pretzels if you want, but you'd just be fooling yourself, wouldn't you?

upgrades.name: Butter slabs
upgrades.q: Nothing butter than a slab to the face.

upgrades.name: Butter swirls
upgrades.q: These are equal parts sugar, butter, and warm fuzzy feelings - all of which cause millions of deaths everyday.

upgrades.name: Shortbread biscuits
upgrades.q: These rich butter cookies are neither short, nor bread. What a country!

upgrades.name: Millionaires' shortbreads
upgrades.q: Three thought-provoking layers of creamy chocolate, hard-working caramel and crumbly biscuit in a poignant commentary of class struggle.

upgrades.name: Caramel cookies
upgrades.q: The polymerized carbohydrates adorning these cookies are sure to stick to your teeth for quite a while.

upgrades.name: Lombardia cookies
upgrades.q: These come from those farms with the really good memory.

upgrades.name: Bastenaken cookies
upgrades.q: French cookies made of delicious cinnamon and candy sugar. These do not contain Nuts!

upgrades.name: Pecan sandies
upgrades.q: Stick a nut on a cookie and call it a day! Name your band after it! Whatever!

upgrades.name: Moravian spice cookies
upgrades.q: Popular for being the world's moravianest cookies.

upgrades.name: Anzac biscuits
upgrades.q: Army biscuits from a bakery down under, containing no eggs but yes oats.

upgrades.name: Buttercakes
upgrades.q: Glistening with cholesterol, these cookies moistly straddle the line between the legal definition of a cookie and just a straight-up stick of butter.

upgrades.name: Ice cream sandwiches
upgrades.q: In an alternate universe, "ice cream sandwich" designates an ice cream cone filled with bacon, lettuce, and tomatoes. Maybe some sprinkles too.

upgrades.name: Pink biscuits
upgrades.q: One of the oldest cookies. Traditionally dipped in champagne to soften it, because the French will use any opportunity to drink.

upgrades.name: Whole-grain cookies
upgrades.q: Covered in seeds and other earthy-looking debris. Really going for that "5-second rule" look.

upgrades.name: Candy cookies
upgrades.q: These melt in your hands just a little bit.

upgrades.name: Big chip cookies
upgrades.q: You are in awe at the size of these chips. Absolute units.

upgrades.name: One chip cookies
upgrades.q: You get one.

upgrades.name: Sprinkles cookies
upgrades.q: A bit of festive decorating helps hide the fact that this might be one of the blandest cookies you've ever tasted.

upgrades.name: Peanut butter blossoms
upgrades.q: Topped with a scrumptious chocolate squirt, which is something we really wish we didn't just write.

upgrades.name: No-bake cookies
upgrades.q: You have no idea how these mysterious oven-less treats came to be or how they hold their shape. You're thinking either elephant glue or cold fusion.

upgrades.name: Florentines
upgrades.q: These make up for being the fruitcake of cookies by at least having the decency to feature chocolate.

upgrades.name: Chocolate crinkles
upgrades.q: Non-denominational cookies to celebrate year-round deliciousness, and certainly not Christmas or some other nonsense.

upgrades.name: Maple cookies
upgrades.q: Made with syrup from a land where milk comes in bags, instead of spontaneously pooling at the bottom of your screen depending on your achievements.

upgrades.name: Festivity loops
upgrades.q: These garish biscuits are a perfect fit for children's birthday parties or the funerals of strange, eccentric billionaires.

upgrades.name: Persian rice cookies
upgrades.q: Rose water and poppy seeds are the secret ingredients of these small, butter-free cookies.

upgrades.name: Norwegian cookies
upgrades.q: A flat butter cookie with a sliver of candied cherry on top. It is said that these illustrate the bleakness of scandinavian existentialism.

upgrades.name: Crispy rice cookies
upgrades.q: Fun to make at home! Store-bought cookies are obsolete! Topple the system! There's marshmallows in these! Destroy capitalism!

upgrades.name: Ube cookies
upgrades.q: The tint is obtained by the use of purple yams. According to color symbolism, these cookies are either noble, holy, or supervillains.

upgrades.name: Butterscotch cookies
upgrades.q: The butterscotch chips are just the right amount of sticky, and make you feel like you're eating candy.

upgrades.name: Speculaas
upgrades.q: These crunchy, almost obnoxiously cinnamony cookies are a source of dutch pride. About the origin of the name, one can only speculate.

upgrades.name: Chocolate oatmeal cookies
upgrades.q: These bad boys compensate for lack of a cohesive form and a lumpy, unsightly appearance by being just simply delicious. Something we should all aspire to.

upgrades.name: Molasses cookies
upgrades.q:
Sticky, crackly, and dusted in fine sugar.
Some lunatics have been known to eat these with potatoes.

upgrades.name: Biscotti
upgrades.q: Almonds and pistachios make these very robust cookies slightly more interesting to eat than to bludgeon people with.

upgrades.name: Waffle cookies
upgrades.q: Whether these are cookies with shockingly waffle-like features or simply regular cookie-sized waffles is a debate we're not getting into here.

upgrades.name: Almond cookies
upgrades.q: Sometimes you feel like one of these. Sometimes you don't.

upgrades.name: Hazelnut cookies
upgrades.q: Tastes like a morning stroll through a fragrant forest, minus the clouds of gnats.

upgrades.name: Walnut cookies
upgrades.q: Some experts have pointed to the walnut's eerie resemblance to the human brain as a sign of its sentience - a theory most walnuts vehemently object to.

upgrades.name: Custard creams
upgrades.q:
British lore pits these in a merciless war against bourbon biscuits.
The filling evokes vanilla without quite approaching it.
They're tastier on the inside!

upgrades.name: Bourbon biscuits
upgrades.q:
Two chocolate biscuits joined together with even more chocolate.
The sworn rivals of custard creams, as legend has it.

upgrades.name: Mini-cookies
upgrades.q: Have you ever noticed how the smaller something is, the easier it is to binge on it?

upgrades.name: Profiteroles
upgrades.q: Also known as cream puffs, these pastries are light, fluffy, filled with whipped cream and fun to throw at people when snowballs are running scarce.

upgrades.name: Jelly donut
upgrades.q:
Guaranteed to contain at least 0.3% jelly filling, or your money back.
You can still see the jelly stab wound!

upgrades.name: Glazed donut
upgrades.q: Absolutely gooey with sugar. The hole is the tastiest part!

upgrades.name: Chocolate cake
upgrades.q: The cake is a Portal reference!

upgrades.name: Strawberry cake
upgrades.q: It's not easy to come up with flavor text for something as generic as this, but some would say it's a piece of cake.

upgrades.name: Apple pie
upgrades.q: It is said that some grandmas go rogue and bake these instead.

upgrades.name: Lemon meringue pie
upgrades.q: Meringue is a finicky substance made of sugar and egg whites that requires specific atmospheric conditions to be baked at all. The lemon, as far as we can tell, isn't nearly as picky.

upgrades.name: Butter croissant
upgrades.q:
Look around.
A rude man in a striped shirt bikes past you. He smells of cigarettes and café-au-lait. Somewhere, a mime uses his moustache to make fun of the British. 300 pigeons fly overhead.
Relax. You're experiencing croissant.

upgrades.name: Cookie dough
upgrades.q: Bursting with infinite potential, but can also be eaten as is. Arguably worth the salmonella.

upgrades.name: Burnt cookie
upgrades.q: This cookie flew too close to the sun and is now a shadow of its former self. If only you remembered to set a timer, you wouldn't have this tragedy on your hands...

upgrades.name: A chocolate chip cookie but with the chips picked off for some reason
upgrades.q: This has to be the saddest thing you've ever seen.

upgrades.name: Flavor text cookie
upgrades.q: What you're currently reading is what gives this cookie its inimitable flavor.

upgrades.name: High-definition cookie
upgrades.q: Uncomfortably detailed, like those weird stories your aunt keeps telling at parties.

upgrades.name: Toast
upgrades.q:
A crisp slice of bread, begging for some butter and jam.
Why do people keep proposing these at parties?

upgrades.name: Peanut butter & jelly
upgrades.q: It's time.

upgrades.name: Wookies
upgrades.q: These aren't the cookies you're looking for.

upgrades.name: Cheeseburger
upgrades.q: Absolutely no relation to cookies whatsoever - Orteil just wanted an excuse to draw a cheeseburger.

upgrades.name: One lone chocolate chip
upgrades.q: The start of something beautiful.

upgrades.name: Whoopie pies
upgrades.q: Two chocolate halves joined together by a cream filling. It's got no eyebrows, but you never noticed until now.

upgrades.name: Caramel wafer biscuits
upgrades.q: Coated in delicious chocolate. As many layers as you'll get in a biscuit without involving onions.

upgrades.name: Chocolate chip mocha cookies
upgrades.q: Mocha started out as an excuse to smuggle chocolate into coffee. And now, in a poignant display of diplomacy and cultural exchange, it's bringing coffee to chocolate cookies.

upgrades.name: Earl Grey cookies
upgrades.q: Captain Picard's favorite.

upgrades.name: Corn syrup cookies
upgrades.q: The corn syrup makes it extra chewy. Not the type of stuff you'd think to put in a cookie, but bakers make do.

upgrades.name: Icebox cookies
upgrades.q: Can be prepared in a variety of shapes with a variety of ingredients. Made by freezing dough before baking it, mirroring a time-proven medieval torture practice. Gotta keep them guessing.

upgrades.name: Graham crackers
upgrades.q: Inspired in their design by the wish to live a life of austere temperance, free from pleasure or cheer; it's no wonder these are so tasty.

upgrades.name: Hardtack
upgrades.q:
Extremely hard and, if we're being honest, extremely tack.
If you're considering eating this as a fun snack, you probably have other things to worry about than this game, like getting scurvy or your crew fomenting mutiny.

upgrades.name: Cornflake cookies
upgrades.q: They're grrrrrroovy! Careful not to let it sit in your milk too long, lest you accidentally end up with a bowl of cereal and get confused.

upgrades.name: Tofu cookies
upgrades.q: There's really two ways to go with tofu cooking; either it asserts itself in plain sight or it camouflages itself in the other ingredients. This happens to be the latter, and as such, you can't really tell the difference between this and a regular cookie, save for that one pixel on the left.

upgrades.name: Gluten-free cookies
upgrades.q:
Made with browned butter and milk to closely match the archetypal chocolate chip cookie.
For celiacs, a chance to indulge in a delicious risk-free pastry. For others, a strangely threatening confection whose empty eyes will never know heaven nor hell.

upgrades.name: Russian bread cookies
upgrades.q: Also known as alphabet cookies; while most bakers follow the recipe to the letter, it is said that some substitute the flour for spelt. But don't take my word for it.

upgrades.name: Lebkuchen
upgrades.q:
Diverse cookies from Germany, fragrant with honey and spices, often baked around Christmas.
Once worn by warriors of old for protection in battle.
+5 STR, +20% magic resistance.

upgrades.name: Aachener Printen
upgrades.q: The honey once used to sweeten these gingerbread-like treats has since been swapped out for beet sugar, providing another sad example of regressive evolution.

upgrades.name: Canistrelli
upgrades.q: A dry biscuit flavored with anise and wine, tough like the people of Corsica where it comes from.

upgrades.name: Nice biscuits
upgrades.q: Made with coconut and perfect with tea. Traces its origins to a French city so nice they named it that.

upgrades.name: French pure butter cookies
upgrades.q: You can't tell what's stronger coming off these - the smell of butter or condescension.

upgrades.name: Petit beurre
upgrades.q:
An unassuming biscuit whose name simply means "little butter". Famed and feared for its four ears and forty-eight teeth.
When it hears ya, it'll get ya...

upgrades.name: Nanaimo bars
upgrades.q: A delicious no-bake pastry hailing from Canada. Probably beats eating straight-up snow with maple syrup poured on it, but what do I know.

upgrades.name: Berger cookies
upgrades.q: Messily slathered with chocolate fudge, but one of the most popular bergers of Baltimore, along with the triple fried egg berger and the blue crab cheeseberger.

upgrades.name: Chinsuko
upgrades.q: A little piece of Okinawa in cookie form. Part of a Japanese custom of selling sweets as souvenirs. But hey, pressed pennies are cool too.

upgrades.name: Panda koala biscuits
upgrades.q:
Assorted jungle animals with equally assorted fillings.
Comes in chocolate, strawberry, vanilla and green tea.
Eat them all before they go extinct!

upgrades.name: Putri salju
upgrades.q: A beloved Indonesian pastry; its name means "snow princess", for the powdered sugar it's coated with. Had we added these to Cookie Clicker some years ago, this is where we'd make a reference to that one Disney movie, but it's probably time to let it go.

upgrades.name: Milk cookies
upgrades.q: Best eaten with a tall glass of chocolate.

upgrades.name: Cookie crumbs
upgrades.q:
There used to be a cookie here. Now there isn't.
Good heavens, what did you DO?!

upgrades.name: Chocolate chip cookie
upgrades.q: This is the cookie you've been clicking this whole time. It looks a bit dented and nibbled on, but it's otherwise good as new.

upgrades.name: Skull cookies
upgrades.q: Wanna know something spooky? You've got one of these inside your head RIGHT NOW.

upgrades.name: Ghost cookies
upgrades.q: They're something strange, but they look pretty good!

upgrades.name: Bat cookies
upgrades.q: The cookies this town deserves.

upgrades.name: Slime cookies
upgrades.q: The incredible melting cookies!

upgrades.name: Pumpkin cookies
upgrades.q: Not even pumpkin-flavored. Tastes like glazing. Yeugh.

upgrades.name: Eyeball cookies
upgrades.q: When you stare into the cookie, the cookie stares back at you.

upgrades.name: Spider cookies
upgrades.q: You found the recipe on the web. They do whatever a cookie can.

upgrades.name: Christmas tree biscuits
upgrades.q: Whose pine is it anyway?

upgrades.name: Snowflake biscuits
upgrades.q: Mass-produced to be unique in every way.

upgrades.name: Snowman biscuits
upgrades.q: It's frosted. Doubly so.

upgrades.name: Holly biscuits
upgrades.q: You don't smooch under these ones. That would be the mistletoe (which, botanically, is a smellier variant of the mistlefinger).

upgrades.name: Candy cane biscuits
upgrades.q:
It's two treats in one!
(Further inspection reveals the frosting does not actually taste like peppermint, but like mundane sugary frosting.)

upgrades.name: Bell biscuits
upgrades.q: What do these even have to do with christmas? Who cares, ring them in!

upgrades.name: Present biscuits
upgrades.q: The prequel to future biscuits. Watch out!

upgrades.name: Dragon cookie
upgrades.q: Imbued with the vigor and vitality of a full-grown cookie dragon, this mystical cookie will embolden your empire for the generations to come.

upgrades.name: Milk chocolate butter biscuit
upgrades.q:
Rewarded for owning 100 of everything.
It bears the engraving of a fine entrepreneur.

upgrades.name: Dark chocolate butter biscuit
upgrades.q:
Rewarded for owning 150 of everything.
It is adorned with the image of an experienced cookie tycoon.

upgrades.name: White chocolate butter biscuit
upgrades.q:
Rewarded for owning 200 of everything.
The chocolate is chiseled to depict a masterful pastry magnate.

upgrades.name: Ruby chocolate butter biscuit
upgrades.q:
Rewarded for owning 250 of everything.
Covered in a rare red chocolate, this biscuit is etched to represent the face of a cookie industrialist gone mad with power.

upgrades.name: Lavender chocolate butter biscuit
upgrades.q:
Rewarded for owning 300 of everything.
This subtly-flavored biscuit represents the accomplishments of decades of top-secret research. The molded design on the chocolate resembles a well-known entrepreneur who gave their all to the ancient path of baking.

upgrades.name: Elderwort biscuits
upgrades.q: They taste incredibly stale, even when baked fresh.

upgrades.name: Bakeberry cookies
upgrades.q: Really good dipped in hot chocolate.

upgrades.name: Duketater cookies
upgrades.q: Fragrant and mealy, with a slight yellow aftertaste.

upgrades.name: Green yeast digestives
upgrades.q: These are tastier than you'd expect, but not by much.

upgrades.name: Wheat slims
upgrades.q: The only reason you'd consider these to be cookies is because you feel slightly sorry for them.

upgrades.name: Synthetic chocolate green honey butter biscuit
upgrades.q:
Rewarded for owning 350 of everything.
The recipe for this butter biscuit was once the sole heritage of an ancient mountain monastery. Its flavor is so refined that only a slab of lab-made chocolate specifically engineered to be completely tasteless could complement it.
Also it's got your face on it.

upgrades.name: Royal raspberry chocolate butter biscuit
upgrades.q:
Rewarded for owning 400 of everything.
Once reserved for the megalomaniac elite, this unique strain of fruity chocolate has a flavor and texture unlike any other. Whether its exorbitant worth is improved or lessened by the presence of your likeness on it still remains to be seen.

upgrades.name: Ultra-concentrated high-energy chocolate butter biscuit
upgrades.q:
Rewarded for owning 450 of everything.
Infused with the power of several hydrogen bombs through a process that left most nuclear engineers and shareholders perplexed. Currently at the center of some rather heated United Nations meetings. Going in more detail about this chocolate would violate several state secrets, but we'll just add that someone's bust seems to be pictured on it. Perhaps yours?

upgrades.name: Pure pitch-black chocolate butter biscuit
upgrades.q:
Rewarded for owning 500 of everything.
This chocolate is so pure and so flawless that it has no color of its own, instead taking on the appearance of whatever is around it. You're a bit surprised to notice that this one isn't stamped with your effigy, as its surface is perfectly smooth (to the picometer) - until you realize it's quite literally reflecting your own face like a mirror.

upgrades.name: Forwards from grandma
upgrades.q: RE:RE:thought you'd get a kick out of this ;))

upgrades.name: Steel-plated rolling pins
upgrades.q: Just what you kneaded.

upgrades.name: Lubricated dentures
upgrades.q: squish

upgrades.name: Cheap hoes
upgrades.q: Rake in the dough!

upgrades.name: Fertilizer
upgrades.q: It's chocolate, I swear.

upgrades.name: Cookie trees
upgrades.q: A relative of the breadfruit.

upgrades.name: Sturdier conveyor belts
upgrades.q: You're going places.

upgrades.name: Child labor
upgrades.q: Cheaper, healthier workforce.

upgrades.name: Sweatshop
upgrades.q: Slackers will be terminated.

upgrades.name: Sugar gas
upgrades.q: A pink, volatile gas, found in the depths of some chocolate caves.

upgrades.name: Megadrill
upgrades.q: You're in deep.

upgrades.name: Ultradrill
upgrades.q: Finally caved in?

upgrades.name: Vanilla nebulae
upgrades.q:
If you removed your space helmet, you could probably smell it!
(Note: don't do that.)

upgrades.name: Wormholes
upgrades.q: By using these as shortcuts, your ships can travel much faster.

upgrades.name: Frequent flyer
upgrades.q: Come back soon!

upgrades.name: Antimony
upgrades.q: Actually worth a lot of mony.

upgrades.name: Essence of dough
upgrades.q: Extracted through the 5 ancient steps of alchemical baking.

upgrades.name: True chocolate
upgrades.q: The purest form of cacao.

upgrades.name: Ancient tablet
upgrades.q: A strange slab of peanut brittle, holding an ancient cookie recipe. Neat!

upgrades.name: Insane oatling workers
upgrades.q: ARISE, MY MINIONS!

upgrades.name: Soul bond
upgrades.q: So I just sign up and get more cookies? Sure, whatever!

upgrades.name: Flux capacitors
upgrades.q: Bake to the future.

upgrades.name: Time paradox resolver
upgrades.q: No more fooling around with your own grandmother!

upgrades.name: Quantum conundrum
upgrades.q:
There is only one constant, and that is universal uncertainty.
Or is it?

upgrades.name: Prune juice
upgrades.q: Gets me going.

upgrades.name: Genetically-modified cookies
upgrades.q: All-natural mutations.

upgrades.name: Radium reactors
upgrades.q: Gives your cookies a healthy glow.

upgrades.name: Ultimadrill
upgrades.q: Pierce the heavens, etc.

upgrades.name: Warp drive
upgrades.q: To boldly bake.

upgrades.name: Ambrosia
upgrades.q:
Adding this to the cookie mix is sure to make them even more addictive!
Perhaps dangerously so.
Let's hope you can keep selling these legally.

upgrades.name: Sanity dance
upgrades.q:
We can change if we want to.
We can leave our brains behind.

upgrades.name: Causality enforcer
upgrades.q: What happened, happened.

upgrades.name: Farmer grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Farms gain +1% CpS per grandma.
upgrades.q: A nice farmer to grow more cookies.

upgrades.name: Miner grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Mines gain +1% CpS per 2 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A nice miner to dig more cookies.

upgrades.name: Worker grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Factories gain +1% CpS per 3 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A nice worker to manufacture more cookies.

upgrades.name: Cosmic grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Shipments gain +1% CpS per 7 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A nice thing to... uh... cookies.

upgrades.name: Transmuted grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Alchemy labs gain +1% CpS per 8 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A nice golden grandma to convert into more cookies.

upgrades.name: Altered grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Portals gain +1% CpS per 9 grandmas.
upgrades.q: a NiCe GrAnDmA tO bA##########

upgrades.name: Grandmas' grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Time machines gain +1% CpS per 10 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A nice grandma's nice grandma to bake double the cookies.

upgrades.name: Sugar bosons
upgrades.q: Sweet firm bosons.

upgrades.name: String theory
upgrades.q: Reveals new insight about the true meaning of baking cookies (and, as a bonus, the structure of the universe).

upgrades.name: Large macaron collider
upgrades.q: How singular!

upgrades.name: Big bang bake
upgrades.q: And that's how it all began.

upgrades.name: Antigrandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Antimatter condensers gain +1% CpS per 11 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A mean antigrandma to vomit more cookies.

upgrades.name: Double-thick glasses
upgrades.q: Oh... so THAT's what I've been baking.

upgrades.name: Gingerbread scarecrows
upgrades.q: Staring at your crops with mischievous glee.

upgrades.name: Recombobulators
upgrades.q: A major part of cookie recombobulation.

upgrades.name: H-bomb mining
upgrades.q: Questionable efficiency, but spectacular nonetheless.

upgrades.name: Chocolate monoliths
upgrades.q: My god. It's full of chocolate bars.

upgrades.name: Aqua crustulae
upgrades.q:
Careful with the dosing - one drop too much and you get muffins.
And nobody likes muffins.

upgrades.name: Brane transplant
upgrades.q: This refers to the practice of merging higher dimensional universes, or "branes", with our own, in order to facilitate transit (and harvesting of precious cookie dough).

upgrades.name: Yestermorrow comparators
upgrades.q: Fortnights into milleniums.

upgrades.name: Reverse cyclotrons
upgrades.q: These can uncollision particles and unspin atoms. For... uh... better flavor, and stuff.

upgrades.name: Gem polish
upgrades.q:
Get rid of the grime and let more light in.
Truly, truly outrageous.

upgrades.name: 9th color
upgrades.q: Delve into untouched optical depths where even the mantis shrimp hasn't set an eye!

upgrades.name: Chocolate light
upgrades.q:
Bask into its cocoalescence.
(Warning: may cause various interesting albeit deadly skin conditions.)

upgrades.name: Grainbow
upgrades.q: Remember the different grains using the handy Roy G. Biv mnemonic: R is for rice, O is for oats... uh, B for barley?...

upgrades.name: Pure cosmic light
upgrades.q: Your prisms now receive pristine, unadulterated photons from the other end of the universe.

upgrades.name: Rainbow grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Prisms gain +1% CpS per 12 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A luminous grandma to sparkle into cookies.

upgrades.name: Aging agents
upgrades.q: Counter-intuitively, grandmas have the uncanny ability to become more powerful the older they get.

upgrades.name: Pulsar sprinklers
upgrades.q: There's no such thing as over-watering. The moistest is the bestest.

upgrades.name: Deep-bake process
upgrades.q: A patented process increasing cookie yield two-fold for the same amount of ingredients. Don't ask how, don't take pictures, and be sure to wear your protective suit.

upgrades.name: Coreforge
upgrades.q: You've finally dug a tunnel down to the Earth's core. It's pretty warm down here.

upgrades.name: Generation ship
upgrades.q: Built to last, this humongous spacecraft will surely deliver your cookies to the deep ends of space, one day.

upgrades.name: Origin crucible
upgrades.q: Built from the rarest of earths and located at the very deepest of the largest mountain, this legendary crucible is said to retain properties from the big-bang itself.

upgrades.name: Deity-sized portals
upgrades.q: It's almost like, say, an elder god could fit through this thing now. Hypothetically.

upgrades.name: Far future enactment
upgrades.q: The far future enactment authorizes you to delve deep into the future - where civilization has fallen and risen again, and cookies are plentiful.

upgrades.name: Nanocosmics
upgrades.q:
The theory of nanocosmics posits that each subatomic particle is in fact its own self-contained universe, holding unfathomable amounts of energy.
This somehow stacks with the nested universe theory, because physics.

upgrades.name: Glow-in-the-dark
upgrades.q: Your prisms now glow in the dark, effectively doubling their output!

upgrades.name: Taller tellers
upgrades.q: Able to process a higher amount of transactions. Careful though, as taller tellers tell tall tales.

upgrades.name: Scissor-resistant credit cards
upgrades.q: For those truly valued customers.

upgrades.name: Acid-proof vaults
upgrades.q: You know what they say: better safe than sorry.

upgrades.name: Chocolate coins
upgrades.q: This revolutionary currency is much easier to melt from and into ingots - and tastes much better, for a change.

upgrades.name: Exponential interest rates
upgrades.q: Can't argue with mathematics! Now fork it over.

upgrades.name: Financial zen
upgrades.q: The ultimate grail of economic thought; the feng shui of big money, the stock market yoga - the Heimlich maneuver of dimes and nickels.

upgrades.name: Golden idols
upgrades.q: Lure even greedier adventurers to retrieve your cookies. Now that's a real idol game!

upgrades.name: Sacrifices
upgrades.q: What's a life to a gigaton of cookies?

upgrades.name: Delicious blessing
upgrades.q: And lo, the Baker's almighty spoon came down and distributed holy gifts unto the believers - shimmering sugar, and chocolate dark as night, and all manner of wheats. And boy let me tell you, that party was mighty gnarly.

upgrades.name: Sun festival
upgrades.q: Free the primordial powers of your temples with these annual celebrations involving fire-breathers, traditional dancing, ritual beheadings and other merriments!

upgrades.name: Enlarged pantheon
upgrades.q: Enough spiritual inadequacy! More divinities than you'll ever need, or your money back! 100% guaranteed!

upgrades.name: Great Baker in the sky
upgrades.q: This is it. The ultimate deity has finally cast Their sublimely divine eye upon your operation; whether this is a good thing or possibly the end of days is something you should find out very soon.

upgrades.name: Pointier hats
upgrades.q: Tests have shown increased thaumic receptivity relative to the geometric proportions of wizardly conic implements.

upgrades.name: Beardlier beards
upgrades.q: Haven't you heard? The beard is the word.

upgrades.name: Ancient grimoires
upgrades.q: Contain interesting spells such as "Turn Water To Drool", "Grow Eyebrows On Furniture" and "Summon Politician".

upgrades.name: Kitchen curses
upgrades.q: Exotic magic involved in all things pastry-related. Hexcellent!

upgrades.name: School of sorcery
upgrades.q: This cookie-funded academy of witchcraft is home to the 4 prestigious houses of magic: the Jocks, the Nerds, the Preps, and the Deathmunchers.

upgrades.name: Dark formulas
upgrades.q: Eldritch forces are at work behind these spells - you get the feeling you really shouldn't be messing with those. But I mean, free cookies, right?

upgrades.name: Banker grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Banks gain +1% CpS per 4 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A nice banker to cash in more cookies.

upgrades.name: Priestess grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Temples gain +1% CpS per 5 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A nice priestess to praise the one true Baker in the sky.

upgrades.name: Witch grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Wizard towers gain +1% CpS per 6 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A nice witch to cast a zip, and a zoop, and poof! Cookies.

upgrades.name: Xtreme walkers
upgrades.q: Complete with flame decals and a little horn that goes "toot".

upgrades.name: Fudge fungus
upgrades.q:
A sugary parasite whose tendrils help cookie growth.
Please do not breathe in the spores. In case of spore ingestion, seek medical help within the next 36 seconds.

upgrades.name: Planetsplitters
upgrades.q: These new state-of-the-art excavators have been tested on Merula, Globort and Flwanza VI, among other distant planets which have been curiously quiet lately.

upgrades.name: Cyborg workforce
upgrades.q: Semi-synthetic organisms don't slack off, don't unionize, and have 20% shorter lunch breaks, making them ideal labor fodder.

upgrades.name: Way of the wallet
upgrades.q: This new monetary school of thought is all the rage on the banking scene; follow its precepts and you may just profit from it.

upgrades.name: Creation myth
upgrades.q: Stories have been circulating about the origins of the very first cookie that was ever baked; tales of how it all began, in the Dough beyond time and the Ovens of destiny.

upgrades.name: Cookiemancy
upgrades.q: There it is; the perfected school of baking magic. From summoning chips to hexing nuts, there is not a single part of cookie-making that hasn't been improved tenfold by magic tricks.

upgrades.name: Dyson sphere
upgrades.q: You've found a way to apply your knowledge of cosmic technology to slightly more local endeavors; this gigantic sphere of meta-materials, wrapping the solar system, is sure to kick your baking abilities up a notch.

upgrades.name: Theory of atomic fluidity
upgrades.q: Pushing alchemy to its most extreme limits, you find that everything is transmutable into anything else - lead to gold, mercury to water; more importantly, you realize that anything can -and should- be converted to cookies.

upgrades.name: End of times back-up plan
upgrades.q: Just in case, alright?

upgrades.name: Great loop hypothesis
upgrades.q: What if our universe is just one instance of an infinite cycle? What if, before and after it, stretched infinite amounts of the same universe, themselves containing infinite amounts of cookies?

upgrades.name: The Pulse
upgrades.q: You've tapped into the very pulse of the cosmos, a timeless rhythm along which every material and antimaterial thing beats in unison. This, somehow, means more cookies.

upgrades.name: Lux sanctorum
upgrades.q: Your prism attendants have become increasingly mesmerized with something in the light - or maybe something beyond it; beyond us all, perhaps?

upgrades.name: The Unbridling
upgrades.q: It might be a classic tale of bad parenting, but let's see where grandma is going with this.

upgrades.name: Wheat triffids
upgrades.q:
Taking care of crops is so much easier when your plants can just walk about and help around the farm.
Do not pet. Do not feed. Do not attempt to converse with.

upgrades.name: Canola oil wells
upgrades.q: A previously untapped resource, canola oil permeates the underground olifers which grant it its particular taste and lucrative properties.

upgrades.name: 78-hour days
upgrades.q: Why didn't we think of this earlier?

upgrades.name: The stuff rationale
upgrades.q: If not now, when? If not it, what? If not things... stuff?

upgrades.name: Theocracy
upgrades.q:
You've turned your cookie empire into a perfect theocracy, gathering the adoration of zillions of followers from every corner of the universe.
Don't let it go to your head.

upgrades.name: Rabbit trick
upgrades.q:
Using nothing more than a fancy top hat, your wizards have found a way to simultaneously curb rabbit population and produce heaps of extra cookies for basically free!
Resulting cookies may or may not be fit for vegans.

upgrades.name: The final frontier
upgrades.q: It's been a long road, getting from there to here. It's all worth it though - the sights are lovely and the oil prices slightly more reasonable.

upgrades.name: Beige goo
upgrades.q: Well now you've done it. Good job. Very nice. That's 3 galaxies you've just converted into cookies. Good thing you can hop from universe to universe.

upgrades.name: Maddening chants
upgrades.q: A popular verse goes like so: "jau'hn madden jau'hn madden aeiouaeiouaeiou brbrbrbrbrbrbr"

upgrades.name: Cookietopian moments of maybe
upgrades.q: Reminiscing how things could have been, should have been, will have been.

upgrades.name: Some other super-tiny fundamental particle? Probably?
upgrades.q: When even the universe is running out of ideas, that's when you know you're nearing the end.

upgrades.name: Reverse shadows
upgrades.q: Oh man, this is really messing with your eyes.

upgrades.name: Lucky grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Chancemakers gain +1% CpS per 13 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A fortunate grandma that always seems to find more cookies.

upgrades.name: Your lucky cookie
upgrades.q: This is the first cookie you've ever baked. It holds a deep sentimental value and, after all this time, an interesting smell.

upgrades.name: "All Bets Are Off" magic coin
upgrades.q: A coin that always lands on the other side when flipped. Not heads, not tails, not the edge. The other side.

upgrades.name: Winning lottery ticket
upgrades.q: What lottery? THE lottery, that's what lottery! Only lottery that matters!

upgrades.name: Four-leaf clover field
upgrades.q: No giant monsters here, just a whole lot of lucky grass.

upgrades.name: A recipe book about books
upgrades.q: Tip the scales in your favor with 28 creative new ways to cook the books.

upgrades.name: Leprechaun village
upgrades.q: You've finally become accepted among the local leprechauns, who lend you their mythical luck as a sign of friendship (as well as some rather foul-tasting tea).

upgrades.name: Improbability drive
upgrades.q: A strange engine that turns statistics on their head. Recommended by the Grandmother's Guide to the Bakery.

upgrades.name: Antisuperstistronics
upgrades.q: An exciting new field of research that makes unlucky things lucky. No mirror unbroken, no ladder unwalked under!

upgrades.name: Reverse dementia
upgrades.q: Extremely unsettling, and somehow even worse than the regular kind.

upgrades.name: Humane pesticides
upgrades.q: Made by people, for people, from people and ready to unleash some righteous scorching pain on those pesky insects that so deserve it.

upgrades.name: Mole people
upgrades.q: Engineered from real human beings within your very labs, these sturdy little folks have a knack for finding the tastiest underground minerals in conditions that more expensive machinery probably wouldn't survive.

upgrades.name: Machine learning
upgrades.q: You figured you might get better productivity if you actually told your workers to learn how to work the machines. Sometimes, it's the little things...

upgrades.name: Edible money
upgrades.q: It's really quite simple; you make all currency too delicious not to eat, solving world hunger and inflation in one fell swoop!

upgrades.name: Sick rap prayers
upgrades.q: With their ill beat and radical rhymes, these way-hip religious tunes are sure to get all the youngins who thought they were 2 cool 4 church back on the pews and praying for more! Wicked!

upgrades.name: Deluxe tailored wands
upgrades.q: In this age of science, most skillful wand-makers are now long gone; but thankfully - not all those wanders are lost.

upgrades.name: Autopilot
upgrades.q: Your ships are now fitted with completely robotic crews! It's crazy how much money you save when you don't have to compensate the families of those lost in space.

upgrades.name: The advent of chemistry
upgrades.q: You know what? That whole alchemy nonsense was a load of baseless rubbish. Dear god, what were you thinking?

upgrades.name: The real world
upgrades.q: It turns out that our universe is actually the twisted dimension of another, saner plane of reality. Time to hop on over there and loot the place!

upgrades.name: Second seconds
upgrades.q: That's twice as many seconds in the same amount of time! What a deal! Also, what in god's name!

upgrades.name: Quantum comb
upgrades.q: Quantum entanglement is one of those things that are so annoying to explain that we might honestly be better off without it. This is finally possible thanks to the quantum comb!

upgrades.name: Crystal mirrors
upgrades.q: Designed to filter more light back into your prisms, reaching levels of brightness that reality itself had never planned for.

upgrades.name: Bunnypedes
upgrades.q: You've taken to breeding rabbits with hundreds of paws, which makes them intrinsically very lucky and thus a very handy (if very disturbing) pet.

upgrades.name: Timeproof hair dyes
upgrades.q: Why do they always have those strange wispy pink dos? What do they know about candy floss that we don't?

upgrades.name: Barnstars
upgrades.q: Ah, yes. These help quite a bit. Somehow.

upgrades.name: Mine canaries
upgrades.q: These aren't used for anything freaky! The miners just enjoy having a pet or two down there.

upgrades.name: Brownie point system
upgrades.q: Oh, these are lovely! You can now reward your factory employees for good behavior, such as working overtime or snitching on coworkers. 58 brownie points gets you a little picture of a brownie, and 178 of those pictures gets you an actual brownie piece for you to do with as you please! Infantilizing? Maybe. Oodles of fun? You betcha!

upgrades.name: Grand supercycles
upgrades.q: We let the public think these are complicated financial terms when really we're just rewarding the bankers with snazzy bicycles for a job well done. It's only natural after you built those fancy gold swimming pools for them, where they can take a dip and catch Kondratiev waves.

upgrades.name: Psalm-reading
upgrades.q: A theologically dubious and possibly blasphemous blend of fortune-telling and scripture studies.

upgrades.name: Immobile spellcasting
upgrades.q: Wizards who master this skill can now cast spells without having to hop and skip and gesticulate embarrassingly, which is much sneakier and honestly quite a relief.

upgrades.name: Restaurants at the end of the universe
upgrades.q: Since the universe is spatially infinite, and therefore can be construed to have infinite ends, you've opened an infinite chain of restaurants where your space truckers can rest and partake in some home-brand cookie-based meals.

upgrades.name: On second thought
upgrades.q: Disregard that last upgrade, alchemy is where it's at! Your eggheads just found a way to transmute children's nightmares into rare metals!

upgrades.name: Dimensional garbage gulper
upgrades.q: So we've been looking for a place to dispose of all the refuse that's been accumulating since we started baking - burnt cookies, failed experiments, unruly workers - and well, we figured rather than sell it to poor countries like we've been doing, we could just dump it in some alternate trash dimension where it's not gonna bother anybody! Probably!

upgrades.name: Additional clock hands
upgrades.q: It seemed like a silly idea at first, but it turns out these have the strange ability to twist time in interesting new ways.

upgrades.name: Baking Nobel prize
upgrades.q: What better way to sponsor scientific growth than to motivate those smarmy nerds with a meaningless award! What's more, each prize comes with a fine print lifelong exclusive contract to come work for you (or else)!

upgrades.name: Reverse theory of light
upgrades.q: A whole new world of physics opens up when you decide that antiphotons are real and posit that light is merely a void in shadow.

upgrades.name: Revised probabilistics
upgrades.q: Either something happens or it doesn't. That's a 50% chance! This suddenly makes a lot of unlikely things very possible.

upgrades.name: Good manners
upgrades.q: Apparently these ladies are much more amiable if you take the time to learn their strange, ancient customs, which seem to involve saying "please" and "thank you" and staring at the sun with bulging eyes while muttering eldritch curses under your breath.

upgrades.name: Lindworms
upgrades.q: You have to import these from far up north, but they really help areate the soil!

upgrades.name: Bore again
upgrades.q: After extracting so much sediment for so long, you've formed some veritable mountains of your own from the accumulated piles of rock and dirt. Time to dig through those and see if you find anything fun!

upgrades.name: "Volunteer" interns
upgrades.q: If you're bad at something, always do it for free.

upgrades.name: Rules of acquisition
upgrades.q: Rule 387: a cookie baked is a cookie kept.

upgrades.name: War of the gods
upgrades.q: An interesting game; the only winning move is not to pray.

upgrades.name: Electricity
upgrades.q: Ancient magicks and forbidden hexes shroud this arcane knowledge, whose unfathomable power can mysteriously turn darkness into light and shock an elephant to death.

upgrades.name: Universal alphabet
upgrades.q: You've managed to chart a language that can be understood by any sentient species in the galaxy; its exciting vocabulary contains over 56 trillion words that sound and look like sparkly burps, forming intricate sentences that usually translate to something like "give us your cookies, or else".

upgrades.name: Public betterment
upgrades.q: Why do we keep trying to change useless matter into cookies, or cookies into even better cookies? Clearly, the way of the future is to change the people who eat the cookies into people with a greater understanding, appreciation and respect for the cookies they're eating. Into the vat you go!

upgrades.name: Embedded microportals
upgrades.q: We've found out that if we bake the portals into the cookies themselves, we can transport people's taste buds straight into the taste dimension! Good thing your army of lawyers got rid of the FDA a while ago!

upgrades.name: Nostalgia
upgrades.q: Your time machine technicians insist that this is some advanced new time travel tech, and not just an existing emotion universal to mankind. Either way, you have to admit that selling people the same old cookies just because it reminds them of the good old times is an interesting prospect.

upgrades.name: The definite molecule
upgrades.q: Your scientists have found a way to pack a cookie into one single continuous molecule, opening exciting new prospects in both storage and flavor despite the fact that these take up to a whole year to digest.

upgrades.name: Light capture measures
upgrades.q: As the universe gets ever so slightly dimmer due to you converting more and more of its light into cookies, you've taken to finding new and unexplored sources of light for your prisms; for instance, the warm glow emitted by a pregnant woman, or the twinkle in the eye of a hopeful child.

upgrades.name: 0-sided dice
upgrades.q: The advent of the 0-sided dice has had unexpected and tumultuous effects on the gambling community, and saw experts around the world calling you both a genius and an imbecile.

upgrades.name: Metagrandmas
upgrades.desc:
Grandma production doubled.
Fractal engines gain +1% CpS per 14 grandmas.
upgrades.q: A fractal grandma to make more grandmas to make more cookies.

upgrades.name: Metabakeries
upgrades.q: They practically bake themselves!

upgrades.name: Mandelbrown sugar
upgrades.q: A substance that displays useful properties such as fractal sweetness and instant contact lethality.

upgrades.name: Fractoids
upgrades.q: Here's a frun fract: all in all, these were a terrible idea.

upgrades.name: Nested universe theory
upgrades.q:
Asserts that each subatomic particle is host to a whole new universe, and therefore, another limitless quantity of cookies.
This somehow stacks with the theory of nanocosmics, because physics.

upgrades.name: Menger sponge cake
upgrades.q: Frighteningly absorbent thanks to its virtually infinite surface area. Keep it isolated in a dry chamber, never handle it with an open wound, and do not ever let it touch a body of water.

upgrades.name: One particularly good-humored cow
upgrades.q: This unassuming bovine was excruciatingly expensive and it may seem at first like you were ripped off. On closer inspection however, you notice that its earrings (it's wearing earrings) are actually fully functional copies of itself, each of which also wearing their own cow earrings, and so on, infinitely. It appears your dairy concerns will be taken care of for a while, although you'll have to put up with the cow's annoying snickering.

upgrades.name: Chocolate ouroboros
upgrades.q: Forever eating its own tail and digesting itself, in a metabolically dubious tale of delicious tragedy.

upgrades.name: Nested
upgrades.q: Clever self-reference or shameful cross-promotion? This upgrade apparently has the gall to advertise a link to <u>orteil.dashnet.org/nested</u>, in a tooltip you can't even click.

upgrades.name: Space-filling fibers
upgrades.q:
This special ingredient has the incredible ability to fill the local space perfectly, effectively eradicating hunger in those who consume it!
Knowing that no hunger means no need for cookies, your marketers urge you to repurpose this product into next-level packing peanuts.

upgrades.name: Endless book of prose
upgrades.q: Snatched right out of the library of Babel.

upgrades.name: The set of all sets
upgrades.q: The answer, of course, is a definite maybe.

upgrades.name: Reinforced index finger
upgrades.desc: Tapping and cursors are twice as efficient.
upgrades.q: prod prod

upgrades.name: Carpal tunnel prevention cream
upgrades.desc: Tapping and cursors are twice as efficient.
upgrades.q: it... it hurts to click...

upgrades.name: Ambidextrous
upgrades.desc: Tapping and cursors are twice as efficient.
upgrades.q: Look ma, both hands!

upgrades.name: Thousand fingers
upgrades.desc: Tapping and cursors gain +0.1 cookies for each non-cursor object owned.
