upgrades.q: There's plenty of knowledgeable people up here, and you've been given some excellent pointers.

upgrades.name: Angels
upgrades.desc:
Power click production while the game is closed sped up to one every 28 minutes.
Maximum power click capacity increased to 10.
upgrades.q: Lowest-ranking at the first sphere of pastry heaven, angels are tasked with delivering new recipes to the mortals they deem worthy.

upgrades.name: Archangels
upgrades.desc:
Power click production while the game is closed sped up to one every 26 minutes.
Maximum power click capacity increased to 15.
upgrades.q: Members of the first sphere of pastry heaven, archangels are responsible for the smooth functioning of the world's largest bakeries.

upgrades.name: Virtues
upgrades.desc:
Power click production while the game is closed sped up to one every 24 minutes.
Maximum power click capacity increased to 20.
upgrades.q: Found at the second sphere of pastry heaven, virtues make use of their heavenly strength to push and drag the stars of the cosmos.

upgrades.name: Dominions
upgrades.desc:
Power click production while the game is closed sped up to one every 22 minutes.
Maximum power click capacity increased to 25.
upgrades.q: Ruling over the second sphere of pastry heaven, dominions hold a managerial position and are in charge of accounting and regulating schedules.

upgrades.name: Cherubim
upgrades.desc:
Power click production while the game is closed sped up to one every 20 minutes.
Maximum power click capacity increased to 30.
upgrades.q: Sieging at the first sphere of pastry heaven, the four-faced cherubim serve as heavenly bouncers and bodyguards.

upgrades.name: Seraphim
upgrades.desc:
Power click production while the game is closed sped up to one every 18 minutes.
Maximum power click capacity increased to 35.
upgrades.q: Leading the first sphere of pastry heaven, seraphim possess ultimate knowledge of everything pertaining to baking.

upgrades.name: God
upgrades.desc:
Power click production while the game is closed sped up to one every 16 minutes.
Maximum power click capacity increased to 40.
upgrades.q: Like Santa, but less fun.

upgrades.name: Belphegor
upgrades.desc: Power click effects increased to 3 times more cookies per click and +6% cookie production for 15 seconds.
upgrades.q: A demon of shortcuts and laziness, Belphegor commands machines to do work in his stead.

upgrades.name: Mammon
upgrades.desc: Power click effects increased to 4 times more cookies per click and +7% cookie production for 20 seconds.
upgrades.q: The demonic embodiment of wealth, Mammon requests a tithe of blood and gold from all his worshippers.

upgrades.name: Abaddon
upgrades.desc: Power click effects increased to 5 times more cookies per click and +8% cookie production for 25 seconds.
upgrades.q: Master of overindulgence, Abaddon governs the wrinkler brood and inspires their insatiability.

upgrades.name: Satan
upgrades.desc: Power click effects increased to 6 times more cookies per click and +9% cookie production for 30 seconds.
upgrades.q: The counterpoint to everything righteous, this demon represents the nefarious influence of deceit and temptation.

upgrades.name: Asmodeus
upgrades.desc: Power click effects increased to 7 times more cookies per click and +10% cookie production for 35 seconds.
upgrades.q: This demon with three monstrous heads draws his power from the all-consuming desire for cookies and all things sweet.

upgrades.name: Beelzebub
upgrades.desc: Power click effects increased to 8 times more cookies per click and +11% cookie production for 40 seconds.
upgrades.q: The festering incarnation of blight and disease, Beelzebub rules over the vast armies of pastry inferno.

upgrades.name: Lucifer
upgrades.desc: Power click effects increased to 9 times more cookies per click and +12% cookie production for 45 seconds.
upgrades.q: Also known as the Lightbringer, this infernal prince's tremendous ego caused him to be cast down from pastry heaven.

upgrades.name: Season switcher
upgrades.desc: Allows you to trigger seasonal events at will, for a price.
upgrades.q: There will always be time.

upgrades.name: Fortune cookies
upgrades.desc: The news ticker may occasionally have fortunes, which may be clicked for something good.
upgrades.q: These don't taste all that great but that's not really the point, is it?

upgrades.name: Starspawn
upgrades.desc:
Eggs drop 10% more often.
Golden cookies appear 2% more often during Easter.

upgrades.name: Starsnow
upgrades.desc:
Christmas cookies drop 5% more often.
Reindeer appear 5% more often.

upgrades.name: Starterror
upgrades.desc:
Spooky cookies drop 10% more often.
Golden cookies appear 2% more often during Halloween.

upgrades.name: Starlove
upgrades.desc:
Heart cookies are 50% more powerful.
Golden cookies appear 2% more often during Valentine's day.

upgrades.name: Startrade
upgrades.desc: Golden cookies appear 5% more often during Business day.

upgrades.name: Keepsakes
upgrades.desc: Seasonal random drops have a 1/5 chance to carry over through ascensions.
upgrades.q: Cherish the memories.

upgrades.name: Unshackled flavor
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Plain-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: While the absence of flavoring may seem underwhelming, it allows innate aromas to be expressed at their most unadulterated.

upgrades.name: Unshackled berrylium
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Berrylium-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: Berrylium is a synthetic gem with a simple shine to it. Sticky to the touch and susceptible to melting in high heat, it is frequently used in the food industry rather than as adornment, as its atomic structure imparts it a vaguely fruity flavor.

upgrades.name: Unshackled blueberrylium
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Blueberrylium-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: Blueberrylium is a refinement of berrylium, sharing nearly the same chemical makeup save for a few supplemental esters. These affect its flavor as well as its visual spectrum resonance.

upgrades.name: Unshackled chalcedhoney
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Chalcedhoney-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: Raw chalcedhoney is found in complex nodules within the fossilized remains of ancient forests. Once purified, it becomes a semi-valuable stone with a pleasant, waxy smell.

upgrades.name: Unshackled buttergold
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Buttergold-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: Buttergold was famously invented by the chef son of two molecular physicists. Neither closely related to butter nor to gold, yet similar in nutritional value, this glimmering substance can be frozen and preserve its hardness at room temperature, only regaining its malleability when heated up.

upgrades.name: Unshackled sugarmuck
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Sugarmuck-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: Sugarmuck refers to the gradual crust that seems to form spontaneously in the vicinity of candy-making equipment. Long ignored by confectioners, its harvesting process was discovered simultaneously in multiple countries during a global beet shortage.

upgrades.name: Unshackled jetmint
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Jetmint-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: The striking taste of jetmint made it popular in the manufacture of various kinds of coffee-side treats until the awareness of its mild radioactivity became widespread. Today, its main uses are in cosmetics, owing to the refreshing sensation it produces on contact.

upgrades.name: Unshackled cherrysilver
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Cherrysilver-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: Cherrysilver is a patented alloy with peculiar aromatic properties; it is non-edible, but produces strong flavor responses while losing very little of its mass when licked, though this also leaves a harmless red tinge upon the tongue.

upgrades.name: Unshackled hazelrald
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Hazelrald-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: Hazelrald is a friable gemstone with complex green-brown inner reflections. It is considered ornamental in some cultures; in others, it may be consumed in small quantities as an upper-scale sweet.

upgrades.name: Unshackled mooncandy
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Mooncandy-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: While many get it mixed up with the trademarked snack of the same name made popular following its discovery, mooncandy is a very real mineral, first isolated within the space dust underneath astronaut boots. Left to its own devices in open air, a mooncandy crystal naturally spreads out and grows.

upgrades.name: Unshackled astrofudge
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Astrofudge-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: When you heat up the shimmering syrup oozing from mooncandy using a special caramelization process, you get astrofudge. Astrofudge is delicious and safe for humanoid consumption in certain quantities. Consult your local food safety agency for more details.

upgrades.name: Unshackled alabascream
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Alabascream-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: Molecularly related to dairy, alabascream occurs naturally at high altitudes, forming in wispy filaments which were long indistinguishable from clouds. An expensive delight, it is also known as "pilots' bane".

upgrades.name: Unshackled iridyum
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Iridyum-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: Iridyum shares little in common with any other material known to mankind. Rather than simply smelled, it can be tasted from a distance, though remaining in its presence too long is ill-advised. Some high-end underground megacomputers may incorporate iridyum as part of their electronic components.

upgrades.name: Unshackled glucosmium
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Glucosmium-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: Glucosmium is a glossy metal whose flavor matrix is bound to its current subjective chroma; in other words, its taste depends on which colors it's currently reflecting. Impractical to consume safely, its industrial applications range from transcontinental ballistics to paint varnish.

upgrades.name: Unshackled glimmeringue
upgrades.desc:
Unshackles all Glimmeringue-tier upgrades, making them more powerful.
Only applies to unshackled buildings.
upgrades.q: Lightweight, digestible, and endlessly fragile, glimmeringue not only enjoys a privileged place in the "spectacle cooking" industry - it also shares most of its other properties with asbestos, save for thermal insulation.

upgrades.name: Unshackled cursors
upgrades.desc: Multiplies the gain from Thousand fingers by 25.
upgrades.q: These hands tell a story.

upgrades.name: Unshackled grandmas
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Grandmas provide an extra +50% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Never too old.

upgrades.name: Unshackled farms
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Farms provide an extra +180% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Till the universe.

upgrades.name: Unshackled mines
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Mines provide an extra +170% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Redefine the meaning of "depth".

upgrades.name: Unshackled factories
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Factories provide an extra +160% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Nothing to lose but your production chains.

upgrades.name: Unshackled banks
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Banks provide an extra +150% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: All-time highs, all the time.

upgrades.name: Unshackled temples
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Temples provide an extra +140% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: You can make a religion out of this.

upgrades.name: Unshackled wizard towers
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Wizard towers provide an extra +130% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: There's a spell for everything.

upgrades.name: Unshackled shipments
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Shipments provide an extra +120% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Distances nullified.

upgrades.name: Unshackled alchemy labs
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Alchemy labs provide an extra +110% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Anything you see, you can make.

upgrades.name: Unshackled portals
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Portals provide an extra +100% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Parallels unparalleled.

upgrades.name: Unshackled time machines
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Time machines provide an extra +90% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: All the time in the world.

upgrades.name: Unshackled antimatter condensers
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Antimatter condensers provide an extra +80% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: No scale too large or too little.

upgrades.name: Unshackled prisms
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Prisms provide an extra +70% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Brilliance has no upper limit.

upgrades.name: Unshackled chancemakers
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Chancemakers provide an extra +60% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: You make the rules.

upgrades.name: Unshackled fractal engines
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Fractal engines provide an extra +50% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Uncontained.

upgrades.name: Unshackled javascript consoles
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Javascript consoles provide an extra +40% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Rewrite your reality.

upgrades.name: Unshackled idleverses
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Idleverses provide an extra +30% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Wait even faster.

upgrades.name: Unshackled cortex bakers
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Cortex bakers provide an extra +20% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Nothing is real. Everything is permitted.

upgrades.name: Unshackled You
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for You provide an extra +10% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Guess who?

upgrades.name: Golden switch
upgrades.desc: Unlocks the golden switch, which passively boosts your CpS by 50% but disables golden cookies.
upgrades.q: Less clicking, more idling.

upgrades.name: Golden switch [off]
upgrades.desc:
Turning this on will passively boost your CpS, but prevents golden cookies from spawning.
Cost is equal to 1 hour of production.

upgrades.name: Golden switch [on]
upgrades.desc:
The switch is currently boosting your CpS; it also prevents golden cookies from spawning.
Turning it off will revert those effects.
Cost is equal to 1 hour of production.

upgrades.name: Residual luck
upgrades.desc: While the golden switch is on, you gain an additional +10% CpS per golden cookie upgrade owned.
upgrades.q: Fortune comes in many flavors.

upgrades.name: Distilled essence of redoubled luck
upgrades.desc: Golden cookies (and all other things that spawn, such as reindeer) have 1% chance of being doubled.
upgrades.q: Tastes glittery. The empty phial makes for a great pencil holder.

upgrades.name: Kitten wages
upgrades.desc: Through clever accounting, this actually makes kitten upgrades 10% cheaper.
upgrades.q:
Cats can have little a salary, as a treat.
Cats are expert hagglers and have a keen sense of bargaining, especially in the case of cash.

upgrades.name: Five-finger discount
upgrades.desc: All upgrades are 1% cheaper per 100 cursors.
upgrades.q: Stick it to the man.

upgrades.name: Classic dairy selection
upgrades.desc:
Unlocks the milk selector, letting you pick which milk is displayed under your cookie.
Comes with a variety of basic flavors.
upgrades.q: Don't have a cow, man.

upgrades.name: Fanciful dairy selection
upgrades.desc: Contains more exotic flavors for your milk selector.
upgrades.q: Strong bones for the skeleton army.

upgrades.name: Basic wallpaper assortment
upgrades.desc:
Unlocks the background selector, letting you select the game's background.
Comes with a variety of basic flavors.
upgrades.q: Prioritizing aesthetics over crucial utilitarian upgrades? Color me impressed.

upgrades.name: Distinguished wallpaper assortment
upgrades.desc: Contains more wallpapers for your background selector.
upgrades.q: Do you ever think about the physicality of this place? Are you putting up these wallpapers in your office or something? Where are you, anyway?

upgrades.name: Spaghettification
upgrades.q: Cookies stretched infinitely thin are technically the same cookie. Legally, this means unlimited cookies.

upgrades.name: Accretion sprinkles
upgrades.q: Matter spiraling in at near light-speed heats up into a glowing ring of rainbow sprinkles.

upgrades.name: Hawking radiators
upgrades.q: Your black holes slowly leak warmth back out, which turns out to be the perfect temperature for proofing dough.

upgrades.name: Event horizon ovens
upgrades.q: Time stops at the edge, so cookies never burn. They also never finish baking, but we're working on it.

upgrades.name: Gravitational lensing
upgrades.q: Bends light around the bakery so every customer sees exactly the cookie they wanted.

upgrades.name: Supermassive appetite
upgrades.q: Your black holes have been encouraged to eat more. It's working. Please stand back.

upgrades.name: Singularity frosting
upgrades.q: An infinitely dense dollop of frosting. One serving covers about four billion cookies.

upgrades.name: Wormhole delivery
upgrades.q: Cookies go in one end and come out in a customer's mouth on the other side of the galaxy. Some assembly required.

upgrades.name: Dark flour
upgrades.q: Makes up 85% of all the flour in the universe, yet nobody can see it. Excellent for invisible pastries.

upgrades.name: Tidal kneading
upgrades.q: Gravity kneads the dough for you, pulling and stretching it from every direction at once.

upgrades.name: No-hair theorem
upgrades.q: Black holes have no hair. That's one less thing to find in the cookies.

upgrades.name: Quasar ignition
upgrades.q: Feed a black hole enough cookie dough and it lights up brighter than a trillion suns. Excellent for midnight baking.

upgrades.name: Information paradox
upgrades.q: Recipes thrown in never come out, which is great for protecting trade secrets.

upgrades.name: Kugelblitz
upgrades.q: A black hole made from pure light instead of matter. Bakes cookies with a satisfying crunch.

upgrades.name: White hole reversal
upgrades.q: The opposite of a black hole: nothing goes in, and cookies just keep coming out. Nobody is asking questions.

upgrades.name: Unshackled black holes
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Black holes provide an extra +10% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: They were never really holding back.

upgrades.name: Milky Way
upgrades.q: The original. Named after the milk it was dunked in.

upgrades.name: Spiral arm conveyor
upgrades.q: Cookies ride the galaxy's spiral arms all the way out to the shipping docks. It only takes 200 million years.

upgrades.name: Star nurseries
upgrades.q: Clouds of gas and sugar where young cookie-stars are born and raised.

upgrades.name: Galactic core bakery
upgrades.q: The center of every galaxy is crowded, hot and loud. Perfect for an industrial oven.

upgrades.name: Dark matter halo
upgrades.q: An invisible ring of something holds your galaxies together. You suspect it's caramel.

upgrades.name: Andromeda merger
upgrades.q: Two galaxies colliding at incredible speed. The cookies inside barely notice, but they do get mixed up nicely.

upgrades.name: Nebula icing
upgrades.q: Glowing pastel clouds, light-years wide, piped on in a single swirl.

upgrades.name: Globular clusters
upgrades.q: Tight little balls of very old stars. Great for chewy cookies.

upgrades.name: Interstellar sugar lanes
upgrades.q: Trade routes between the stars, lined with sugar-coated rest stops.

upgrades.name: Cosmic web
upgrades.q: Galaxies are strung together like beads on a necklace, which makes them a lot easier to carry to market.

upgrades.name: Redshift glaze
upgrades.q: Cookies moving away from you look slightly redder. Customers say they taste like strawberry.

upgrades.name: Hubble expansion
upgrades.q: The universe keeps getting bigger, so there's always room for another bakery.

upgrades.name: Galactic federation
upgrades.q: A council of a thousand galaxies has unanimously voted that you deserve more cookies.

upgrades.name: Laniakea
upgrades.q: Your galaxies belong to a supercluster whose name means "immeasurable heaven". The real estate is very expensive.

upgrades.name: The great attractor
upgrades.q: Something out there is pulling every galaxy towards it. You've decided it's your shop.

upgrades.name: Unshackled galaxies
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Galaxies provide an extra +10% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Spin it faster.

upgrades.name: Infinite whisk
upgrades.q: A whisk with more wires than there are atoms. Cleaning it is a different universe's problem.

upgrades.name: Fold in gently
upgrades.q: Universes are delicate. Fold them in slowly, or physics gets lumpy.

upgrades.name: Many-worlds batter
upgrades.q: In every branch of reality, someone is eating one of your cookies. That's a lot of branches.

upgrades.name: Parallel pantry
upgrades.q: Ran out of eggs? Borrow some from a universe where you didn't.

upgrades.name: Quantum creaming
upgrades.q: Butter and sugar are creamed together and not creamed together until somebody looks.

upgrades.name: Probability sifter
upgrades.q: Shakes out the lumpy, unlikely universes, keeping only the smoothest outcomes.

upgrades.name: Alternate you sous-chefs
upgrades.q: Hire the versions of you that went to culinary school. They're a little smug about it.

upgrades.name: Dimensional dough hook
upgrades.q: Kneads dough in seven directions at once. Two of them you can't see.

upgrades.name: Reality emulsifier
upgrades.q: Keeps mutually exclusive universes from separating, like oil and vinegar but much louder.

upgrades.name: Cross-world taste testers
upgrades.q: They try every cookie in every universe, and report back on which one is best. It's always yours.

upgrades.name: Paradox proofing
upgrades.q: Lets the dough rise before you've mixed it. Saves a lot of time.

upgrades.name: Omni-flavor extract
upgrades.q: Every flavor that ever was or could be, in one tiny bottle. Just a drop, please.

upgrades.name: Universe-scale bowl
upgrades.q: Your mixing bowl is now larger than the observable universe. Finding a sink for it remains an issue.

upgrades.name: Turbo setting
upgrades.q: The mixer was never meant to go this fast. Several universes have been flung against the wall.

upgrades.name: Everything everywhere all at once
upgrades.q: Every universe mixed in, every cookie baked, all at the same time. Somehow it still needs to cool on a rack.

upgrades.name: Unshackled multiverse mixers
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Multiverse mixers provide an extra +10% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Set it to eleven.

upgrades.name: Primordial dough
upgrades.q: In the very first second, everything was a hot, dense ball of cookie dough. Some scientists believe it still is.

upgrades.name: Cosmic inflation
upgrades.q: The universe doubled in size a hundred times in a split second. So did your profits.

upgrades.name: Recombination
upgrades.q: As the universe cooled, flour and water finally came together. It took about 380,000 years.

upgrades.name: Background radiation
upgrades.q: A faint, warm glow left over from the beginning of time. It smells faintly of fresh cookies.

upgrades.name: First stars
upgrades.q: The very first stars were huge and very hot. They made excellent ovens.

upgrades.name: Nucleosynthesis
upgrades.q: Forging the heavy elements needed for good cookies: carbon, oxygen, and the rare earth metal chocolatium.

upgrades.name: Big crunch
upgrades.q: Eventually, the universe collapses back into a single point. Satisfying, but very crumbly.

upgrades.name: Big bounce
upgrades.q: After every crunch comes another bang. It's a reliable business model.

upgrades.name: Fine-tuned constants
upgrades.q: Tweaked the laws of physics so that cookies come out slightly chewier.

upgrades.name: Planck-time timer
upgrades.q: A kitchen timer precise to 10^-44 seconds. Overbaking is now impossible.

upgrades.name: Baby universes
upgrades.q: Little pocket universes bud off the big one. They grow up so fast.

upgrades.name: Eternal inflation
upgrades.q: New universes keep popping into existence forever, like popcorn in a microwave that never stops.

upgrades.name: Vacuum decay
upgrades.q: If the universe falls into a lower energy state, everything is replaced by cookies. You've been rooting for it.

upgrades.name: Second law repeal
upgrades.q: Your lawyers successfully argued that entropy shouldn't apply to baked goods.

upgrades.name: Let there be cookies
upgrades.q: And there were cookies, and it was good.

upgrades.name: Unshackled big bangs
upgrades.desc:
Tiered upgrades for Big bangs provide an extra +10% production.
Only works with unshackled upgrade tiers.
upgrades.q: Louder this time.

upgrades.name: Stardust snickerdoodles
upgrades.q: Rolled in cinnamon and a pinch of actual stardust, collected by very patient astronauts.

upgrades.name: Supernova shortbread
upgrades.q: Baked in the last few seconds of a dying star. Crumbly, golden and briefly brighter than the whole galaxy.

upgrades.name: Event horizon brownies
upgrades.q: So rich and dense that not even light can escape. Hard to photograph for the menu.

upgrades.name: Comet crinkles
upgrades.q: Crackled, icy cookies with a long glittery tail of powdered sugar.

upgrades.name: Big bang biscotti
upgrades.q: Twice-baked, at the very beginning of time and again just now. Crunchier than anything in this universe.

upgrades.name: Nebula meringues
upgrades.q: Light, airy and swirled with every color of a starry gas cloud. Mostly air, but very pretty air.

He who controls the cookies controls the universe
achievs.q: The milk must flow!

achievs.name: Are you gonna eat all that?
We're gonna need a bigger bakery
In the mouth of madness
achievs.q: A cookie is just what we tell each other it is.

achievs.name: The dreams in which I'm baking are the best I've ever had
achievs.desc: Bake 100 UnD cookies in one ascension.

achievs.name: Set for life
achievs.desc: Bake 1 DoD cookies in one ascension.

achievs.name: Panic! at Nabisco
achievs.desc: Bake 100 DoD cookies in one ascension.

achievs.name: Bursting at the seams
achievs.desc: Bake 1 TrD cookies in one ascension.

achievs.name: Just about full
achievs.desc: Bake 100 TrD cookies in one ascension.

achievs.name: Hungry for more
achievs.desc: Bake 1 QaD cookies in one ascension.

achievs.name: Feed me, Orteil
achievs.desc: Bake 100 QaD cookies in one ascension.

achievs.name: And then what?
achievs.desc: Bake 1 QiD cookies in one ascension.

achievs.name: I think it's safe to say you've got it made
achievs.desc: Bake 100 QiD cookies in one ascension.

achievs.name: When this baby hits 36 quadrillion cookies per hour
Cookiehertz: a really, really tasty hertz
achievs.q: Tastier than a hertz donut, anyway.

achievs.name: Turbopuns
achievs.q: Mother Nature will be like "slowwwww dowwwwwn".

Adolphus W. Green (1844–1917) started as the Principal of the Groton School in 1864. By 1865, he became second assistant librarian at the New York Mercantile Library; from 1867 to 1869, he was promoted to full librarian. From 1869 to 1873, he worked for Evarts, Southmayd & Choate, a law firm co-founded by William M. Evarts, Charles Ferdinand Southmayd and Joseph Hodges Choate. He was admitted to the New York State Bar Association in 1873.
